input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Verified triple-click mapping or a body-selection equivalent.

result_fields.name: body_selection_state
result_fields.description: Selected complete body identity and direct/equivalent control used.

procedure: Set body/solid selection mode and pre-highlight visible_body.
Use one calibrated triple click, or one verified body-selection filter/menu equivalent.
Observe complete-body highlight and return body_selection_state.
If only a face/edge is selected, stop and return mismatch rather than escalating clicks.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous body, unsupported triple click without equivalent, or partial selection.
Do not assume triple click is cross-version invariant.
